perl -e 'alarm 120; exec @ARGV' ./tests/test_init.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|checks (passed|failed)"; git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Fix the fn+Control binding: poll the release through generic modifier bits

The press and the release are read through two different APIs, and they do not
report the same bits. A flagsChanged event's rawFlags carry the device-specific
bits (deviceLeftControl = 0x1); hs.eventtap.checkKeyboardModifiers(true)._raw
comes from CGEventSourceFlagsState and reports only the generic ones. Posting
rawFlags 0x800001 reads back as 0x800000 — the device bit is simply gone.

So triggerHeld() could never be true: the press was detected, the overlay
appeared, and 0.1s later the release poller decided the key was up and killed the
recording. From the outside the binding looked entirely dead — no UI at all.

Each trigger now carries both masks: `mask` (device bits, matched against the
event) and `heldMask` (generic bits, matched against the polled state). The
suite's stub previously fed triggerHeld a _raw value the real API never returns,
so it passed on broken code; it now feeds the generic flags and adds a check that
fails outright if any device bit appears in a heldMask. 72 checks pass.

Verified end to end by posting a synthetic 6s hold: warmup → 3 chunks → concat →
whisper (auto-detected ru) → action hooks → insertion. Documented both the gotcha
and the simulation recipe in AGENTS.md, plus a rule that .specstory/ is tracked
and pushed like code.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git pull --rebase -q 2>&1|tail -2; git push -q 2>&1|tail -2; git status -sb|head -3
